title: Jaguars list Bhayshul Tuten or Chris Rodriguez as No. 1 running back

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jaguars list Bhayshul Tuten or Chris Rodriguez as No. 1 running back
sources.description: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said last month that the team is expecting running back Bhayshul Tuten to have a big year for them, but Tuten has not nailed down the top spot on the depth chart.
